flags.name: Pizza Box Liner Brown 9"
flags.issue: Costed $21.56 per 'box' with needs_pack_review FALSE, so it looks resolved. Every sibling packaging line is costed PER EACH — Gulli 11"/13"/15" pizza boxes at $0.48/$0.64/$0.79 ea, Pizza Box Inserts at $0.11 ea. A recipe that adds one liner therefore books $21.56 instead of roughly $0.20, a ~100x overstatement on Marilyna's packaging cost. NOT a category problem: packaging belongs in the picker by design (that is how the per-pizza box cost is tracked) — it is the pack size that is wrong.
flags.suggested_fix: Set the pack to the carton's liner COUNT so it costs per each, like the pizza boxes. Count not stated on the invoice — confirm with B&E, do not guess.
